title: Synthesis, Antiproliferative Activity and Molecular Docking Analysis of Both Enantiomerically Pure Decursin Derivatives as Anticancer Agents.
authors: Ahn, Junseong; Hwang, Hyun-Ha; Jung, Soo Yeon; Lee, Ja Yeon; Kim, Choi; Choi, Hye Min; Gwon, Min Ju; Kim, Min Ji; Kwon, Youngbin; Woo, Jaehyuk; Park, Bongkyu; Ko, Seong-Gyu; Lee, Jae Yeol
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗癌化合物的合成、活性及与JAK1的分子对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Using (S)-decursinol isolated from root of Angelica gigas Nakai (AGN), we semi-synthesized and evaluated a series of both enantiomerically pure decursin derivatives for their antiproliferative activities against A549 human lung cancer cells. All synthesized compounds showed a broad spectrum of inhibitory activities against the growth of A549 cells. Especially, compound (S)-2d with (E)-(furan-3-yl)acryloyl group showed the most potent activity (IC(50): 14.03 microM) against A549 cancer cells as compared with the reference compound, decursin (IC(50): 43.55 microM) and its enantiomer, (R)-2d (IC(50): 151.59 microM). Western blotting assays indicated that (S)-2d more strongly inhibited Janus kinase 1 (JAK1) and signal transducer and activator of transcription activation 3 (STAT3) phosphorylation than decursin in a dose-dependent manner, while having no effect on CXCR7 overexpression and total STAT3 level. In addition, (S)-2d induced cell cycle arrest at G1 phase and subsequent apoptotic cell death in A549 cancer cells. Our combined analysis of molecular docking studies and biological data suggests that the inhibition of JAK1 with (S)-2d resulted in loss of STAT3 phosphorylation and inhibition of cell growth in A549 cancer cells. These overall results strongly suggest that (S)-2d (MRC-D-004) as a novel JAK1 inhibitor may have therapeutic potential in the treatment of A549 human lung cancers by targeting the JAK1/STAT3 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 利用从当归（Angelica gigas Nakai, AGN）根中分离得到的(S)-decursinol，我们半合成并评估了一系列对映体纯的decursin衍生物对A549人肺癌细胞的抗增殖活性。所有合成的化合物对A549细胞的生长均表现出广谱抑制活性。特别是，含有(E)-(呋喃-3-基)丙烯酰基的化合物(S)-2d显示出最强的活性（IC(50)：14.03微摩尔），与参考化合物decursin（IC(50)：43.55微摩尔）及其对映体(R)-2d（IC(50)：151.59微摩尔）相比，对A549癌细胞的作用更为显著。Western blotting分析表明，(S)-2d以剂量依赖性方式比decursin更强烈地抑制Janus激酶1（JAK1）和信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）的磷酸化，同时对CXCR7过表达和总STAT3水平无影响。此外，(S)-2d在A549癌细胞中诱导细胞周期阻滞于G1期，并随后导致凋亡性细胞死亡。我们结合分子对接研究和生物学数据的综合分析表明，(S)-2d对JAK1的抑制导致STAT3磷酸化丧失及A549癌细胞生长抑制。这些总体结果强烈提示，(S)-2d（MRC-D-004）作为一种新型JAK1抑制剂，可能通过靶向JAK1/STAT3信号通路在治疗A549人肺癌方面具有治疗潜力。
